text:
Alice Nguyen: uploaded a perfetto trace from last night's p99 spike (17:09 UTC). full trace here: https://perfetto.google.com/trace/REDACTED
Ben Patel: seen. quick skim — looks like a long gap between kernel_select and kernel_launch in the runtime spans.
Alice Nguyen: yeah, runtime_dispatch -> kernel_select ~ 12ms, then kernel_launch ~ 38ms for a subset of requests. total tail adds ~50ms to end-to-end.
Carmen Li: do we have nsys/nvprof captures on the GPU side for those samples? could be kernel queuing or memcopy.
Alice Nguyen: no nvprof for prod trace (can't attach), but we triggered an nsys run on a repro node last night and I pulled the .qdrep. attaching small timeline snippet below.
perfetto-bot: trace uploaded (id: t-20260317-49)
Alice Nguyen: ```perfetto timeline snippet
[client_request] 0.0ms -> 1.2ms
[gateway_proxy] 1.2ms -> 4.8ms
[runtime_dispatch] 4.8ms -> 5.6ms
  -> kernel_select 5.6ms -> 17.6ms  // heuristic evaluation + fallback check
  -> kv_cache_lookup 17.6ms -> 19.0ms
  -> kernel_launch 56.0ms -> 94.0ms // large gap between select end and launch start
[compute] 94.0ms -> 118.0ms
```
Ben Patel: that 38ms idle between select and launch stands out. two hypotheses: (1) kernel selection triggers a slow fallback/model swap path (I/O), or (2) gpu queue backlog due to batching kicks in.
Carmen Li: check batching windows: if client batcher groups tiny requests into 128-token packets, kernel selection might decide different kernel requiring cudaMemPrefetch / declare memory and that could be the I/O.
Alice Nguyen: I grepped logs for "choose_kernel" and saw repeated paths hitting quantized_fallback for ~20% of requests in that trace. stack:
  - model_variant: gptq-4x-8bit
  - selected_kernel: fast_attn_prefetch (preferred)
  - fallback: emulated_kv_merge -> triggers host->device memcpy
Ben Patel: aha. memcpy to device on the hotpath explains kernel_launch delay. memcopy shows up as blocking on stream 0 in nsys.
runtime-ci-bot: nsys job finished on repro node: https://ci.internal/nsys/98765 (qdrep attached)
Alice Nguyen: in the nsys timeline the memcpy is ~35ms for the same traces. looks like prefetch heuristic is too eager when kv cache partial hits occur.
Carmen Li: does our KV prefetch policy attempt to prefetch full KV pages eagerly? maybe it does host->device copies for pages that are only partially needed.
Ben Patel: current heuristic: prefetch if anticipated_next_tokens > threshold && cache_miss_ratio > 0.2. if KV pages are large, we end up copying 4-8KB per request.
Alice Nguyen: suggestion: add micro-batching for prefetches and issue async prefetch on separate stream so kernel_launch isn't blocked on sync memcpy. also consider shrinking prefetch granularity.
Carmen Li: agree. also fallback: if kernel selection triggers fallback to cpu-copy path, we should prefer a compatible kernel variant to avoid memcpy. add a fast path for partial-KV hits.
Ben Patel: actionable items:
  - Alice: open a perf ticket with trace link + nsys qdrep and the grep output (include the heuristic counters). prioritize P1 for next sprint.
  - Carmen: prototype async prefetch on stream 1 and a reduced prefetch size (2KB pages) on repro node.
  - Ben: add an instrumentation flag to log kernel selection reasons (sync vs async, fallback type) with minimal perf cost.
Alice Nguyen: done — ticket RW-2482 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-2482. I attached the perfetto link and nsys qdrep. marking follow-ups in the ticket.
Carmen Li: I'll push a small repro change to the batcher so we can A/B test and measure p99 impact.
Ben Patel: once Carmen has a build, let's run a 1hr perfetto + nsys capture and compare stacked timelines.
Alice Nguyen: thanks. quick note: adding a temporary metric to the console for "kernel_fallback_rate" so we can see regression in staging.
Ben Patel: :thumbsup:
Alice Nguyen: pinging infra to reserve repro GPU for tomorrow morning 9:00 UTC.
runtime-ci-bot: repro GPU reserved: gnode-14 (9:00-12:00 UTC)
Carmen Li: nice. I'll start the async-prefetch branch tonight and leave the test vector used in the trace in the ticket.
